question: A student sketches the electric field due to two like point charges +Q and +q. In the sketch, two field lines appear to cross at a point P between the charges. Which critique best explains why this sketch is incorrect?

options.A: Field lines may cross only when the charges are unequal.
options.B: If lines cross at P, the electric field there would have two directions, which is impossible.
options.C: Field lines are imaginary, so crossing has no physical meaning.
options.D: Field lines can cross only at points where the net field is zero.
